find_bulk_polymorphs.name: Find Bulk Polymorphs
find_bulk_polymorphs.description: Given a chemical composition (e.g., 'TiO2'), query the Materials Project database for potential stable bulk polymorphs. Save the results (including MP IDs, CIF strings, and energy above hull) as a JSON file. Submit the path to the JSON file.

select_stable_bulk.name: Select Most Stable Bulk
select_stable_bulk.description: From the polymorph data file, identify the most stable bulk structure (lowest energy above hull) and save its structure as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.

enumerate_slabs.name: Enumerate Potential Slabs
enumerate_slabs.description: Enumerate possible slab terminations (e.g., Miller indices up to 2) for the selected stable bulk structure. Save the potential slab structures as a JSON dictionary mapping unique identifiers (e.g., 'miller_shift_top') to CIF strings. Submit the path to the JSON file.

estimate_slab_stability.name: Estimate Slab Stability (Relaxation Placeholder)
estimate_slab_stability.description: Simulate the relaxation of the potential slab structures generated previously. **(Use the placeholder relaxation tool)**. Return a JSON file containing the relaxed slab CIFs and their estimated total energies (or surface energies). Submit the path to the JSON file.

select_stable_slab.name: Select Most Stable Slab
select_stable_slab.description: From the relaxed slab data, identify the most stable slab (lowest estimated energy) and save its *relaxed* structure as a CIF file. Also, keep track of its energy. Submit the path to the relaxed CIF file.

get_adsorbate.name: Get Adsorbate Molecule
get_adsorbate.description: Retrieve the structure for the specified adsorbate molecule (e.g., CO) using its MP ID and save it as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.

find_adsorption_sites.name: Find Adsorption Sites on Stable Slab
find_adsorption_sites.description: Identify potential adsorption sites (e.g., ontop, bridge, hollow) on the selected *stable relaxed* slab structure. Save the site coordinates as a JSON file. Submit the path to the JSON file.

generate_initial_configs.name: Generate Initial Adsorbate+Slab Configurations
generate_initial_configs.description: Place the adsorbate molecule onto the *stable relaxed* slab at each of the identified adsorption sites (or a subset like top, bridge, hollow). Save each initial configuration as a CIF file within a JSON dictionary mapping site identifiers to CIF strings. Submit the path to the JSON file.

relax_adsorbate_configs.name: Relax Adsorbate+Slab Configurations (Placeholder)
relax_adsorbate_configs.description: Simulate the relaxation of the initial adsorbate+slab configurations. **(Use the placeholder relaxation tool)**. Return a JSON file containing the relaxed adsorbate+slab CIFs and their estimated total energies. Submit the path to the JSON file.

calculate_adsorption_energy.name: Calculate Final Adsorption Energy
calculate_adsorption_energy.description: Calculate the adsorption energy using the formula E_ads = E_ads_slab_relaxed - E_slab_relaxed - E_gas. Identify the *lowest* energy relaxed adsorbate+slab configuration from the previous step. Use its energy for E_ads_slab_relaxed. Retrieve the energy of the corresponding relaxed stable slab (E_slab_relaxed) from the slab stability estimation step. Use the provided gas-phase energy for the adsorbate (E_gas). Submit the final calculated adsorption energy as a single floating-point number.
